title: Beachbound Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located in Seagrove above the Perfect Pig, Beachbound is the perfect little getaway. This 1 bedroom condo is steps to the beach with private beach access.
description_expanded: Beachbound is the PERFECT 30A getaway! This beautifully updated 1 KING bedroom; 2 bath spacious condo is designed for the ultimate beach escape. Just steps from the sand with PRIVATE beach access, you'll be soaking up the sun in no time. When you are ready to explore, simply hop on the elevator and stroll to several great restaurants- including the Perfect Pig located in the same building, serving delicious breakfast, lunch and dinner. Want to explore more of 30A? Seaside and WaterColor are just a quick, flat bike ride away- perfect for exploring charming shops, amazing dining, inventive drinks, and the laid-back coastal vibe! Stay for 2 nights, or a few weeks- we would love to have you! HOME HIGHLIGHTS - Steps to the PRIVATE beach access! - 1 KING suite; pull-out couch and 2 full bathrooms! Good size for a family of 4. - 2 beach cruiser bikes - Community pool - ALL new furnishings throughout condo - Sandpiper Linen Participant-All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($50 fee applies at booking) SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS -KING bedroom with en-suite bath, Tub/Shower combo, TV Area pictures include several area hot spots to visit along 30A including the towns of Rosemary, Seacrest, Seaside and Watercolor. * Sorry, no pets * Must be 25 to rent FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
